vendor.zh: 阿里巴巴 · 通义千问

generations.zh: 当前代。27B 密集 + 2.4T-A95B MoE + Flash-Next（180B MoE）三线；27B 密集版是本地部署圈热度最高的一档。
generations.en: Current generation. Three lines: 27B dense, 2.4T-A95B MoE, and Flash-Next (180B MoE). The 27B dense build is the most talked-about for local deployment.

generations.zh: 上一代的架构基础——官方 Qwen3.8 README 原文：「Built on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5」。
generations.en: Architectural foundation of the previous generation — the official Qwen3.8 README states: "Built on the architectural foundation of Qwen3.5".

generations.zh: 更早一代的主力，0.6B 到 235B-A22B 全尺寸覆盖，apache-2.0 与混合思考模式从这一代立住。
generations.en: Earlier flagship generation, spanning 0.6B to 235B-A22B; Apache-2.0 licensing and hybrid thinking modes were established here.

sizeTiers.zh: 小杯 0.6B–9B：端侧、免费额度、 CPU 可跑
中杯 14B–35B：本地部署主力（27B 密集为当前代代表）
sizeTiers.en: Medium 14B-35B: the local-deployment workhorse (27B dense leads this generation)

sizeTiers.zh: 大杯 180B–2.4T：MoE 巨杯，需服务器级显存
sizeTiers.en: Large 180B-2.4T: MoE flagships needing server-class VRAM

licenses.en: Apache-2.0 (27B dense and other mainline builds)

licenses.zh: other（Flash-Next 规格的许可以发布页为准）
licenses.en: other (Flash-Next builds: see the release page)

claims.zh: 官方 README：Qwen3.8-27B 是原生视觉-语言模型（「a native vision-language model that understands images and videos」），支持从 STEM 图表到小时级视频的理解。
claims.en: Official README: Qwen3.8-27B is "a native vision-language model that understands images and videos", covering STEM diagrams up to hour-long video.

claims.zh: 官方 README：思考模式默认开启、可按请求关闭，推理深度用 reasoning_effort 调节（主语是托管版；权重版字段以本页配置为准）。
claims.en: Official README: thinking mode is on by default and can be disabled per request, with reasoning depth tuned via reasoning_effort (stated for the hosted version).

claims.zh: 官方 README 提到的托管版「1M context length by default」是云端服务声明，不直接等于权重版上限；权重版上下文以 config 字段为准。
claims.en: The README's "1M context length by default" is a statement about the hosted service, not automatically the weights build; check config for the weights.

positioning.zh: 中文与代码口碑最强的开放权重家族之一；Apache-2.0 主力规格许可干净。本站量化对比的基准系列（qwen3-8）就在这一代。
positioning.en: One of the strongest open-weight families for Chinese and code, with clean Apache-2.0 licensing on mainline builds. This site's benchmark quantisation series (qwen3-8) sits in this generation.

onSite.zh: 本站已收录 Qwen3.8 的量化对比（2 个模型仓 / 18 个量化档）
onSite.en: This site covers Qwen3.8 quantisations (2 repos / 18 tiers)
